html:
An English trading company chartered in 1555 to trade with Russia by the northern sea route through the White Sea. It was one of the first large joint stock companies, in which many investors shared the risk and the profit.

It grew out of a 1553 voyage that set out to find a passage round the north of Asia to China. Two of the three ships froze and their crews died, including the leader Hugh Willoughby. The third, under Richard Chancellor, reached the White Sea, and Chancellor travelled overland to Moscow, where Ivan the Terrible welcomed him.

The company held the English monopoly on Russian trade for well over a century, bringing back furs, wax, hemp, tallow and rope for the navy. Its agent Anthony Jenkinson reached Bukhara and Persia. Its model of a chartered company with shareholders led to the East India Company in 1600. Russia then looked to it as a window on the West, part of Muscovy's trade with Europe.
sum: An English trading company chartered in 1555 to trade with Russia by the northern sea route through the White Sea. It was one of the first large joint stock companies, in which many investors shared the risk and the profit.
